parameters.content:
## Customer email → Claude draft → review in Gmail
New mail under the **Inquiries** label gets a reply drafted by Claude from your business facts, saved as a **Gmail draft in the same thread**. Nothing is sent: you open Gmail, edit, press Send.

Emergencies never reach the model. Drafts that mention a price, a guarantee or a time promise are flagged in the Telegram note.

assignments.name: businessFacts
assignments.value: Northwind Heating & Air. Services: furnace and AC repair and replacement, heat pumps, water heaters. Area: Kansas City, Independence, Liberty. Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 8am-2pm, emergency line 24/7 at (816) 555-0101. We never quote prices by email: a technician gives a free written estimate at the home for replacements. Visits are booked in two-hour windows and confirmed by text.
